matt: Quick one  Yelena's J-1 ends 2026-09-10 and counsel flagged a 212(e) issue. Can people-ops summarize start/benefits/tax implications if waiver delays her US arrival?
yelena: Hi team 60a I can do full remote from my home country for a bit. Would that affect relocation stipend or signing bonus timing?
sophie: Short: payroll needs valid US work auth to run I-9. If we delay US start, we can still do limited remote onboarding (read-only repo, meetings). Relocation and signing bonus payouts usually align to payroll or physical relocation milestones; finance approval required for exceptions.
omar: From counsel: waiver processing + any consular stamping can be 2-6 months, sometimes longer. If Yelena stays abroad and we pay her as a contractor, we must check local tax rules and contractor compliance in her country.
matt: Team ok with remote ramp (pairing, docs, meetings). No prod creds until payroll + BG check clear.
yelena: OK. A couple specific Qs: 1) does equity cliff start on offer date or payroll date? 2) if we pay signing bonus while she's abroad, is there extra tax withholding?
sophie: Equity cliff and vesting anchor to payroll hire date by default. For signing bonus and relocation, payroll has to process payments and taxes; paying while abroad can complicate tax residency and withholding — we'll loop in comp/finance.
benefits-bot: Note: benefits enrollment requires an active employee ID. If hire_date > 15th, benefits effective = 1st of following month per vendor SLA.
omar: Also flag: if consular stamping is required, employee travel and timing vary by country. If company requests travel to complete onboarding, we can discuss coverage case-by-case.
sophie: Action items:
- Yelena: upload DS-2019 + DS-3035 receipt (if any) + passport to secure portal (redact as needed)
- Counsel (Omar): confirm waiver intake and estimate timeline within 7 business days
- People-ops: draft "remote-limited" onboarding checklist and ask finance about relocation/signing bonus advance treatment
- Matt: confirm team OK with no production access and a delayed onsite date if needed
matt: confirmed. please cc me on updates.
yelena: uploading docs now, and I prefer the remote-limited onboarding. Thanks for flexibility! :pray:
sophie: I'll open an HRIS ticket and set hire_state = "pending_work_auth". Expect DM with checklist and a note to finance by EOD tomorrow.
omar: I'll post intake confirmation in this thread within 5bd.
benefits-bot: Recorded provisional state = "pending_work_auth". No benefits enrollment until active payroll record.
